aviato_findings.title: Generic or non-descriptive alt / aria-label values on content images
aviato_findings.explanation: axe-core passes any non-empty alt string, even generic placeholders like alt="image" or alt="product-img". Screen-reader shoppers hear repetitive role words instead of product details.

aviato_findings.title: CSS removes :focus outline (outline: 0 / none) without a visible focus indicator
examples: css/style.css: a, a:focus, a:hover { text-decoration: none; outline: 0; color: #000; }
aviato_findings.explanation: Static axe-core DOM checks do not fail stylesheets that strip :focus outlines, leaving keyboard-only users unable to see where focus is on the page.

aviato_findings.title: Form controls relying on placeholder text without a persistent <label>
examples: index.html: <input type="text" placeholder="Enter Your Email Address"> (no <label>)
aviato_findings.explanation: Placeholders vanish as soon as a user types and often have low contrast; every input needs an explicit <label> or persistent accessible name.

diagnosis.headline: The Themefisher Aviato template suffers from 114 axe-core violations and 22 additional Placebo accessibility defects driven by global CSS overrides, unlabeled interactive controls, and generic template placeholders across all 5 e-commerce pages.

shared_root_causes.title: Global CSS resets stripping focus indicators and link distinguishability
shared_root_causes.axe_impact: Triggers `link-in-text-block` (1 violation) because `a, a:focus, a:hover { text-decoration: none; color: #000; }` removes underlines and sets links to pure black against `#757575` body text, and contributes to `color-contrast` issues (27 violations, 44 incomplete nodes) via low-contrast gray typography and `.btn:focus { color: #ddd; }`.
shared_root_causes.soundcheck_catch: Catches `focus_outline_removed` across 4 global selector groups (`a:focus`, `.btn:focus`, `.slider-item:focus`, `.heroSliderArrow:focus`, plus `input { outline: none; }`) where `outline: 0` removes keyboard focus visibility without a high-contrast replacement.
shared_root_causes.fix_strategy: Remove `outline: 0` and `outline: none` from `css/style.css` in favor of visible `:focus-visible` outlines (e.g., `2px solid #000` with `outline-offset: 2px`), restore `text-decoration: underline` for inline links, and darken muted text tokens beyond `#757575` on `#f9f9f9` backgrounds.

shared_root_causes.title: Unlabeled icon-only links and placeholder-driven form controls
shared_root_causes.axe_impact: Accounts for 84 axe violations: `link-name` (77 violations from icon-only social, cart, search, and product action links), `select-name` (6 violations), and `label` (1 violation).
shared_root_causes.soundcheck_catch: Catches `placeholder_only_form_controls` (7 instances) where global header search inputs (`placeholder="Search..."`), coupon fields, and newsletter inputs rely solely on disappearing `placeholder` attributes instead of persistent `<label>` elements.
shared_root_causes.fix_strategy: Add descriptive `aria-label` attributes or `.sr-only` text to all icon-only `<a>` elements, and pair every `<input>` and `<select>` (including shared header search bars and checkout coupon inputs) with an explicit `<label for="...">`.

shared_root_causes.title: Missing or generic placeholder `alt` attributes on product and cart imagery
shared_root_causes.axe_impact: Triggers `image-alt` (2 violations) where `` elements completely lack an `alt` attribute.
shared_root_causes.soundcheck_catch: Catches `generic_alt_or_aria_name` (11 instances) where template authors satisfied static syntax checks using meaningless strings like `alt="image"` or `alt="Image"` on cart, checkout, and storefront product thumbnails.
shared_root_causes.fix_strategy: Replace all missing and generic `alt="image"` attributes with specific product names and visual descriptions (or `alt=""` for purely decorative graphics).

diagnosis.why_axe_alone_is_not_enough: While axe-core flags missing attributes, it automatically passes syntactically valid anti-patterns such as generic `alt="image"` strings (`generic_alt_or_aria_name`), stylesheet rules that strip `:focus` outlines (`focus_outline_removed`), and inputs that rely on non-persistent `placeholder` text instead of visible labels (`placeholder_only_form_controls`). Placebo catches these 22 semantic and CSS-level barriers that otherwise leave screen-reader shoppers without product context, keyboard users without focus visibility, and cognitive/low-vision users without persistent form labels.
